name: Gardena Benchworks
description: Six-bench contract assembly line for small consumer products. Fastened and snap-fit assemblies, light soldering, bagging and retail boxing.

name: Vernon Kit & Pack
description: Kitting, poly-bagging and retail packaging with pick-and-ship fulfillment out of the same warehouse. No soldering.

name: Burbank Signal Assembly
description: Electronics box-build for audio and film gear: harnessing, through-hole soldering, enclosure fit-out and a functional test on every unit.

name: Arts District Small Batch
description: Maker-run studio that assembles, finishes and hand-packs short runs for independent brands. Paint touch-up, bonding and gift packaging.

name: Van Nuys Precision Assembly
description: Clean-bench mechanical assembly with torque-controlled fastening, bonding and inspection records. Works mostly with machined and cast parts.

name: Carson Fulfillment Co.
description: Light assembly, kitting and direct-to-customer shipping for online sellers, with Etsy and Shopify order sync.

name: Pasadena Proto Line
description: Pilot-run assembly for hardware startups: first articles, fixtures for repeat steps, soldering and a documented test before scale-up.

name: Commerce Line Works
description: Conveyor assembly for mid-size runs of housewares and accessories: fastening, heat-staking, labeling, boxing and palletizing.
